biography: Will Orton, a name whispered with a mix of excitement and exasperation in the British racing scene, hails from a small village nestled in the Cotswolds. Unlike many of his peers who were practically born in go-karts, Will's introduction to motorsport was almost accidental. He stumbled upon a local karting track during a school trip and, captivated by the raw speed and adrenaline, begged his parents for a kart of his own. His early days were marked by spectacular crashes and occasional glimpses of brilliance. His defining moment came during the Ginetta Junior Championship when, starting from the back of the grid after a qualifying mishap, he carved his way through the field to snatch victory on the final corner. Orton's Ginetta career has been a rollercoaster. After flirting with a factory Ginetta drive, Orton is now fighting to maintain his position within the top tier of British GT racing. His raw speed is undeniable, but his consistency remains his Achilles' heel.
drivingStyle: Orton's driving style is a high-risk, high-reward affair. He's known for his late-braking maneuvers and aggressive corner entries, often pushing the car to its absolute limit. While this approach can yield spectacular results, it also leads to costly mistakes and tire degradation. He tends to struggle with tire management, often burning through his rubber in the early stages of a race, leaving him vulnerable in the closing laps. Under pressure, Orton can either rise to the occasion with a stunning overtake or crack and make an unforced error; this inconsistency makes him a thrilling but unpredictable competitor.

rivalries.name: James Thornton
rivalries.reason: A long-standing rivalry stemming from their Ginetta Junior days. Thornton, known for his calculated and consistent approach, often clashes with Orton's aggressive style, creating sparks on and off the track.

rivalries.name: Isabelle Rossi
rivalries.reason: Rossi and Orton have been fierce competitors ever since a controversial incident at Brands Hatch where Orton's aggressive defense forced Rossi into the gravel, costing her a potential podium. The animosity between them is palpable.

rivalries.name: Marcus Beaumont
rivalries.reason: Beaumont, seen as a rising star, openly criticized Orton's driving in a post-race interview, labeling it 'reckless and immature'. Orton responded with a scathing tweet, igniting a heated rivalry.

quirks: Always wears the same lucky pair of socks, regardless of weather.
Listens to the same punk rock song ('Blitzkrieg Bop') before every race.
Has a habit of talking to his car during practice sessions, offering it encouragement (or reprimands).
famousQuote: "You can't win if you're afraid to lose. Sometimes you gotta send it!"
careerHighlight: Winning the Ginetta Junior Championship in 2018 after a season-long battle with James Thornton. Orton secured the title with a dominant performance in the final race at Brands Hatch, showcasing his raw talent and determination.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the British GT Championship race at Silverstone in 2022 while leading, costing his team a potential victory and significantly damaging their championship hopes. The crash was deemed avoidable, leading to criticism from both his team and fans.
